title: Add `label.size` argument to slice plots
description: This addresses #6 by adding a `label.size` argument to `hue_slice()`, `chroma_slice()`, `complement_slice()` and `plot_closest()`, which is passed to `geom_text()`. Default stays at 2. I also added `tests/testthat/test-plot.R`, the first tests for the plotting functions, and a NEWS entry. `devtools::check()` passes with: 0 errors and 0 warnings. **Before:** `hue_slice("5R")` **After:**` hue_slice("5R", label.size = 3.5)`

title: Hopefully fixed issue #10
description: I think this fixes #10. I upped the version to 0.4.4.0000 you may wish to change.  NEWS.md has a summary of the changes.  There are other problems unrelated to #10 which give errors on checking, but the unit tests I added work correctly as far as I can see, when running them separately.
